description: This file defines the CloudZeroLogger class, a specialized logger for exporting usage data to CloudZero's API. It includes methods for initializing export jobs, data transformation, dry runs, and displaying data, as well as setting up periodic background jobs for data export.

classes.name: CloudZeroLogger
classes.description: A specialized logger for exporting usage data to CloudZero's API, handling data export, transformation, dry runs, and background job setup.

methods.name: __init__( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, connection_id: Optional[str] = None, timezone: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the CloudZeroLogger with configuration parameters or environment variables.

methods.name: initialize_cloudzero_export_job(self)
methods.description: Handles the process to initialize and trigger data export to CloudZero, using locking to prevent concurrent exports.

methods.name: _hourly_usage_data_export(self)
methods.description: Exports the last hour's usage data to CloudZero, adjusting for potential missed data due to restarts.

methods.name: export_usage_data( self, limit: Optional[int] = None, operation: str = "replace_hourly", start_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, end_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms and sends usage data to CloudZero, fetching data from the database and handling errors.

methods.name: dry_run_export_usage_data(self, limit: Optional[int] = 10000)
methods.description: Performs a dry run that simulates data export and returns detailed statistics without actually sending data.

methods.name: _display_cbf_data_on_screen(self, cbf_data)
methods.description: Displays transformed CBF data in a formatted table along with summary statistics.

methods.name: init_cloudzero_background_job(scheduler: AsyncIOScheduler)
methods.description: Sets up a periodic background job to automatically export data to CloudZero at configured intervals.
